summary: The reader has an undergraduate computer science degree: algorithm analysis with big-O and recurrences, discrete mathematics (sets, modular arithmetic, primes, induction, permutations), and the linear algebra and complex numbers of the first years (matrices, rank, invertibility, subspaces, norms). They know basic Turing machines with tapes and binary and two's-complement number representation. They have not studied Fourier transforms over rings, FFT-based multiplication, algebraic complexity, or the history of fast multiplication, and have not seen finite-field linear algebra beyond XOR as a bitwise operation.

known.name: Linear algebra over the reals and complex numbers
known.gloss: Matrices and linear maps, matrix products and inverses, subspaces, bases, dimension and rank.

known.name: Linear algebra over GF(2)
known.gloss: Bit vectors under XOR addition, with matrices and subspaces over the two-element field.

known.name: Triangular matrices and Gaussian elimination
known.gloss: Triangular matrices, elementary row operations and factoring or inverting matrices by elimination.

known.name: Modular arithmetic and prime numbers
known.gloss: Arithmetic of remainders modulo m, greatest common divisors, coprimality and prime factorization.

known.name: Binary and two's-complement representation
known.gloss: Writing integers in base 2 or base 2^b and signed integers in two's complement.

known.name: Floor, ceiling, rounding and logarithms
known.gloss: Elementary integer-valued functions and base-2 logarithms.

known.name: Permutations and sorting
known.gloss: Bijective rearrangements of a finite list and the fact that sorting or rearranging n items is a standard cost to account for.

known.name: Cartesian products and mixed-radix indexing
known.gloss: Indexing a multidimensional array by tuples and ordering the tuples lexicographically.

known.name: Vector norms and inequalities
known.gloss: Norms such as the maximum norm, the triangle inequality, and maps that do not increase a norm.

known.name: Geometric series and recurrences
known.gloss: Summing geometric series, solving simple recurrences, and proving bounds by induction.

known.name: Schoolbook multiplication and carries
known.gloss: Multiplying integers digit by digit and propagating carries.

known.name: Roots of unity and Euler's formula
aliases: cyclic sums of roots of unity
known.gloss: The k-th roots of unity, their powers, and the vanishing of their geometric sums.

known.name: Asymptotic conventions
known.gloss: Theta, Omega and little-o notation and the reading of constants as independent of input size.

known.name: Finite-state and constant-size alphabets
known.gloss: Machines with finitely many states and symbols, and encoding larger symbols as blocks of bits.
